what: West pavilion at the end of the curved corridor.
basis: S01 draws it at (8742,1600), plate 1 shows both, west one at the viewer's left. Row keeps the name; add 'west'. A rubble heap stands here.

what: East pavilion, same name as XY01-01 because they are twins, not a double row.
basis: Plan (9018,1602); rubble heap on the ruin close to the row. Read with the row's mark on screen, so don't take the small offset as proof. Box generator draws both.

what: South pool, row already right on today's water.
basis: Plan and ruin agree within 3 m.

what: Not a building: plan's hatched square with stair treads north of the block, tied to it by a wall. Plate 2 shows a double stair on the north side, and S108 a 3-bay porch at the back.
basis: Set 17 m north of the block on the plan. Part of XY01's north stairs, model with the block. The plan's distance is a doubt.

what: East twin of XY01-N02.
basis: As XY01-N02.

what: A bridge named by S06 only; nothing drawn close south of 蓄水楼 on S01. S01 writes 五孔闸 at (8688,1740), three diamond piers on the wall line west of 谐奇趣's lake: same wall, sluice, and 5 openings like S06's 5 arches.
basis: So the row may be that sluice-bridge. S06's 'at the west wall', '水闸 links to YM' and 5 arches fit; its 蓄水楼南 allows it, 138 m south. Not proved. If placed: 40.010618,116.302168, C. It may also be YM43-02: see question.

name_en: two-storey hall at the back of the maze
what: Named by function: Malone's building overlooking the maze. Plate 5 shows it behind the pavilion. Open court of 18 m at the same place in today's rebuilt maze.
basis: S02 p.145; plate 5 P0045; plan B0048 + porch B0047.

name_en: square pavilion on the hill north of the maze
what: Stands outside the maze wall, on the hill in a square wall ~8 m, in the west arm of the T (S604's 320 m reaches it). Hill survives as today's pine mound. Plate 5 shows only trees and hill behind the hall. Its parent CC22 is right; XY04 is not. The id misleads: note, never renumber.
basis: Plan (8883,303) B0008; hill outline drawn on the plan north of the maze wall; a pavilion 5.5 x 5 m as drawn.

name_en: walled court north of 养雀笼
what: Service or keeping court; rooms N, W and E round a yard, gate on the south. The Chinese-roofed hall with windows at the left of plate 6 stands in this place: seen from the west. Not named by a text.
basis: Plate 6 P0046 against plan x 9020-9085, y 959-1018.

what: Same object as XY05-N01: its west range, a block the plan-to-row step cut out of the court.
basis: Plan (9027,998) lies inside the court's outline x 9020-9085.

name_en: bow-tie figure east of the 方外观 axis
what: Not a building. A figure with a narrow centre and two flaring ends, 16 x 10 m as drawn, in the garden south of the moat, 15 m off the axis. Plates 8 and 9 show parterres with scrollwork and no building here; plate 8 lower right has one such bed. Nothing clear on the ruin at the row, which is on the moat's bank.
basis: Plan rect 77 x 46 px; plates P0048, P0049. Keep as a garden feature, not a box. Round 2's generator draws it as a hall: wrong.

name_en: small two-bay building with a rock or pond form, in the garden east of 养雀笼
what: Building drawn, 6.4 x 4.9 m at ground scale, at the north-west corner of 方外观's garden against the wall x=9088; a kidney-shaped form beside it. No plate shows it clearly; not 方外观's. Its mirror is XY07-B0201.
basis: Plan (9128,958). Plate 7's rocks and wall frame the same spot; plate 8's far left shows a small octagon, which is not this two-bay block.

what: Same form at the south-west corner of the same garden, plan (9124,1246). Not part of 五竹亭: 56 m west of XY07's axis and against the same wall as XY06-B0151. Its parent XY07 is a nearest-neighbour tie.
basis: Plan; symmetry about y~1100 with XY06-B0151, centred on 养雀笼's east front.

what: Plan's label read 西水?房, third character like 車. Malone p.155: 'the tallest parts of the building covered the hydraulic machines, and between them lay the reservoir', and plate 11 shows two raised masses with the long range between. West of the reservoir, so the west one. Reading 車 stays likely, not sure.
basis: S01 label at (9998,1107); S02 p.155; plate 11 P0051. Machine out of use by 1786 (S258).

name_en: east block with the zig-zag stairs, the east machine house
what: East raised mass of plate 11, stairs of plate 12. A door on the axis under the stairs in plate 12 is the plan's E-W passage y 1101-1120. Name of a 东水车房 by symmetry only: not written on the plan.
South half of the block in XY08-N02, split only by the passage.
basis: Plate 12 shows one mass.

name_en: south wing of the west block
what: Mirror of plan block B0154, the north wing, in the stepped outline of the west block (the reader's A-cc_xyl-001 at (9840,1192)). The box generator's west block already covers it.
basis: named.csv XY08 note; plate 10, 13.

name_en: north range behind 远瀛观, west part
what: Not 远瀛观's wings: those are inside B0096's 5 bays (two end pavilions with clock roofs on plate 14). A low service range on the north wall, 40 m behind the hall on the plan, turning south at the end. No plate shows it. Under today's tree row and path north of the fence; the excavation of 2016 is not known to me to have reached it.
basis: Plan B0069; plate P0054.

what: As XY09-N01, six rooms in a row.
basis: Plan B0070.

what: As XY09-N01, mirror. Plan B0071, B0072 drawn as one group.

Malone's 'excessively tall pyramidal fountains', plate 15 at far left, in a round pool with small jets. Base and pool both drawn. '13 tiers' is S109, S06 and not from the plate: `perspective` counts. The two slim tiered poles in plate 15's middle foreground are clipped trees, not these.
basis: S02 p.156; plate 15 P0055; S603 quatrefoil basins 18 m.

what: Twin of XY10-N01, plate 15 far right.
basis: As XY10-N01.

what: Five bays, north edge of the stage set, 5-bay B0155. No plate names it: plate 20 is taken from the lake along the axis, and the big arched fronts in it face west, so they are the first screens, not these ranges.
basis: Plan; plate P0060.

what: Mirror, B0215.
basis: As XY15-N01.
